Union Strong!

It was an honor to join our hardworking Nurses and clinicians from @MassNurses on the picket line this morning to demand that Mass General/Brigham Hospital return to the bargaining table and reach a fair and equitable contract with the MNA. My thanks to @RepRichardNeal, @EdforBoston, Democratic nominee for Congress @dank, and MNA leadership for fighting for affordable and reliable health care for all. 

Our nurses and clinicians are the heart and soul of our healthcare system - they are always there for us, and I’m proud to stand in solidarity with them!

text:
We need to double down on our skills training pipelines.

Yesterday, I joined the Eastern CT Workforce Investment Board to mark 10 years of the Manufacturing Pipeline Initiative. 

EWIB released a detailed economic report that confirms that the pipeline has made eastern Connecticut the highest region of employment growth in Connecticut from 2020-2025- by 33%. 

Since the program launched, over 6,400 trainees have been placed into jobs at over 670 employers.

The Manufacturing Pipeline Initiative is still expanding, and with the historic demand signal for submarine construction from the recently awarded $76.6 billion Navy contracts, I will continue to secure funding so the program reach even more young people and adult jobseekers in our region.
